coverage.actual_feature_policy: all serialized features; targets are not maxima; failed extraction actual count unavailable
coverage.fallback_fused_policy: verify frozen equality; count fallback once

geometry.absolute_feature_coordinate: serialized feature coordinate plus own layer tl
geometry.official_M0: nearest-neighbor affine warp of exact official mask crop, constant0 border
geometry.official_selection_domain: erode each M_l with default3x3, one iteration, BORDER_REPLICATE
geometry.empty_selection_domain: unrestricted; official M/E are diagnostic reference only
geometry.binary_content_B1: pyrDown(M0), floor-half size, default BORDER_DEFAULT; remains grayscale
geometry.rectangular_support_A0: warp all-one CV32F crop using RGB INTER_LINEAR affine and constant0 border
geometry.rectangular_support_A1: pyrDown A0 using actual source size/default border
geometry.alpha_membership: exact0, strictly0to1, exact1 with float32 bits; no fitted epsilon
geometry.signed_distance: integer Chebyshev distance to opposite class; inside positive, outside negative; extend masks with zero outside canvas
geometry.spatial_partition: fixed4x4 official-bbox cells plus outside; no fitted grid
geometry.orientation: all eight serialized labels only; continuous theta not serialized

support_claims_to_test.future_bandwidth: undecided;4px is only a receptive-field candidate and omits hysteresis support

minimal_planned_execution.failure: preserve evidence and stop; no sampling or silent omission

pin_expansion_contract.anchors: input_pins below are actual metadata/source hashes at design time, not blanket validation of their transitive files
pin_expansion_contract.training_masks: exact432 object/image/mask path+sha256+bytes records from RGB INPUT_CLOSURE.training, cross-equal binary closure; only these image bytes may open
pin_expansion_contract.rgb_bank_members: six frozen_inputs/obj*/rgb_training bank, metadata, attempts, config records in RGB INPUT_CLOSURE.private_files
pin_expansion_contract.treatment_bank_members: all six banks,metadata,attempts,geometry,configs listed in each BANK_FREEZE.files
pin_expansion_contract.quality_members: full raw/member manifests,selected,per-frame,ground_truth,retention/equality/summary from each QUALITY_STAGE_FREEZE; deduplicate RGB occurrence source
pin_expansion_contract.sources: exact V11,pose helper,observer,independent bank parser,auditor and tests plus compiler/runtime closure before execution
pin_expansion_contract.before_after: hash all consumed bytes and exact member sets before/after; do not use full inherited image checker that reads pairedRGB or development images
pin_expansion_contract.external_prerequisites: pinned not vendored; OS/API-set dynamic resources outside closure must be stated

limits: No descriptor changes,no retraining,no thresholds or NMS changes,no performance measurement
Only already serialized selected features observed; failed partial features unknown
Region association is not gradient provenance,extractor causation or proof of artificial boundary
No NMS blocker or rejected candidate observation without a separate trace experiment
Native mask warp/pyrDown geometry independently fixture-tested; numeric Python audit does not independently reconstruct pixels
All templates,all failures,all GT and negative-frame usage retained; no object/identity-specific selection

geometry_pack_contract.container: lossless jsonl.gz rowRLE or bitpack for binary masks
geometry_pack_contract.coverage: every pixel of every shared geometry pose
geometry_pack_contract.independent_queries: standard-library interval queries or complete expansion; all selected feature distances and flags replayed
forbidden: silent scope reduction on size failure

usage_interpretation: Counts refer to saved post-threshold/post-consolidation representative template IDs, not every pre-consolidation generating template; zero saved usage does not mean never matched.
dataset_root_from_anchor: RGB INPUT_CLOSURE.dataset_root; resolved paths must remain under that root and equal the explicit432-mask allowlist.
